name: Akako Miller
details: Can create stable, two-way portals between any two locations she has memorized the precise coordinates of.

name: Amir Yaoyorozu
details: Subject can create unbreakable highly reflective invisible threads that can be wrapped around others to control them, or used to pull the user's body to locations where threads are attached.

name: Arthur Stormborne
details: Can create and manipulate black-colored electricity with unique properties distinct from standard electrical generation quirks. Exact differences under study.

name: Chiyo Shuuzenji
details: Allows the user to accelerate and amplify the target's healing process with a kiss, using the target's own stamina as fuel.

name: Denki Kaminari
details: Allows the user to generate electricity and discharge it in various ways. Overuse causes temporary mental impairment.

name: Eijiro Kirishima
details: Allows the user to harden and sharpen their body to become nearly indestructible. The harder the user hardens, the more stamina it consumes.

name: Eva Yaoyorozu
details: Can manipulate the robotic components of her body, transforming them into various forms and tools limited only by imagination and understanding of mechanics. Requires further study.

name: Fumikage Tokoyami
details: Allows the user to manifest a sentient shadow monster from their body. Stronger in darkness but harder to control. Weaker in light but more manageable.

name: Hanta Sero
details: Allows the user to shoot tape-like material from their elbows. The tape is strong enough to support weight and can be used for binding or mobility.

name: Hizashi Yamada
details: Allows the user to emit a blinding flash of light from their body, temporarily incapacitating those who look directly at it. The intensity and duration of the flash can be controlled.

name: Haruto Sero
details: The ability to manipulate gravitational forces in a localized area. Can increase, decrease, or redirect gravity affecting objects and individuals.
